start: A member with 150 workouts over a year, on the Profile tab's Workouts feed

user_sees: Cards newest first, under month headings with that month's count
Each card: 'Today' / 'Yesterday' or the date, the workout's name, top exercises with '· +2 more', working sets and kg lifted
must_not: A month heading whose count differs from its cards
Warm-up sets counted as working sets

steps.action: Keep scrolling past the first page
user_sees: More workouts load as the end nears, with no gap or repeat
must_not: A workout shown twice at a page edge
The list jumping back to the top

user_sees: Only workouts with an exercise whose name has 'bench', or a title or note with it
Month counts that match the search
must_not: Month counts of the whole history while searching

user_sees: Untitled workouts of the Push day type too
must_not: Titled workouts matched only by their day type

start: A member on a chart who taps 'See these workouts' for one week, or a day on the Calendar

steps.action: Tap the week's box on a chart
user_sees: Screen 'Your workouts' with '3 workouts in <that week>'
Or that workout's page straight away when the week has exactly one

steps.action: Open Calendar and tap a day with 2 workouts
user_sees: Both workouts of that day, newest first

start: A member whose search matches nothing, or a chart week with no workout

steps.action: Search 'zzz' or open a range with no workouts
user_sees: An empty list with plain words; for a range 'You did not log a workout in <that week>.'
Only workouts whose text has '100%' or '_'
must_not: Every workout listed because % or _ acted as a wildcard

start: A member on History who deletes a workout, then comes back to the tab

steps.action: Delete a workout from its page and go back
user_sees: The workout gone from the list and its month count one lower
must_not: The list shrinking under the thumb when older pages were loaded

steps.action: Come back at 00:01 the next day without changes

start: A member signed in to a gym, on History

user_sees: Only this member's own workouts on this phone
must_not: Workouts of another member or a gym's demo mixed in
